about: DeepSeek Harness headless: `dsh headless <task>` answers one task, prints the result and exits.
_note:
The headless bundle uses provider deepseek-official, which reads DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. Keep the key in the macOS keychain:
  security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s deepseek-api -w 'sk-...'
The shell form is resolved only when an agent is spawned, so the key never sits in a dotfile or in this repo.
